intro: Below are representative engagements highlighting the kinds of systems I have delivered, the constraints I navigated, and the outcomes that mattered to stakeholders.

projects.title: GenAI Transformation
projects.summary: Observability program leveraging a meaningful generative AI solution

problems.title: Solving the reactive nature of incident management
problems.context: Multiple customers signed up for an observability program. While app & log monitoring were assisting clients assess failures the nature of the provided solution was highly reactive.
problems.problem: Redesign & deliver an AI first observability automation solution
problems.resolution: Setup a RAG solution that initially used runbooks, logs & system metrics as trigger mechanisms. Then built eval framework to ascertain success metrics. Coordinated between platform & SRE teams across customers to fast track deployment pilot while enforcing guardrails. Scaled to more stakeholders via feedback loops for continuous improvement.
problems.outcome:
1. Reduced MTTR by 40%
2. Cut escalations to L3 by 30%
3. Delivered unit's first GenAI project that is being adopted by more customers

problems.title: API first scalable managed services setup
problems.context: Slower revenue recognition by average of 8 weeks due to lack of scalable mechanisms in existing managed services setup
problems.problem: Managed services team was drowning in one-off integrations per customer, causing 60% of engineering time to be spent on repetitive onboarding work
problems.resolution: Designed a scalable managed services workflow, involving API first operating model to reduce onboarding time. Turned tribal knowledge to reusable assets by mapping end-to-end user journeys. Ensured mechanism over memorisation
problems.outcome:
1. Accelerated revenue recognition by €1M due to faster go-lives.
2. Reduced onboarding time from eight to three weeks.
3. Enabled team to handle 3x more work.

problems.title: Deliver business impact, showcasing bias for action
problems.context: Program introduced automated troubleshooting leveraging LLM models and past data to identify potential issues. However there were several false positives that made the signals triggered to be unreliable
problems.problem: AI driven troubleshooting was at risk of being defunded after initial project pilots. Feedback received was that it may "not be ready for prime"
problems.resolution: Dove deep into failure modes to identify the root cause was poor training data & unclear success metrics. Rebranded the product as AI co-pilot rather than an AI automation to lower nerves around replacing resources
problems.outcome:
1. Achieved 85% adaption among alpha users by reducing their troubleshooting time by 40%
2. Secured executive approval to expand this for two more clients

projects.title: Large scale IT transformation
projects.summary: Managed services program that involved end-to-end application support for a world leading logistics client

problems.title: Managing complex stakeholder relationship
problems.context: Multiple simultaneous knowledge transition lead to increased response times. There were noticeable gaps in satisfactory incident resolution
problems.problem: During a period of increase in volume of work and offshoring team strength, customer satisfaction was waning
problems.resolution: Voluntarily picked the role of incident manager. It involved diving deep beyond just incident closure. Learned to be skeptical when metrics and anecdotes differ. Built playbooks to resolve repeated incidents.
problems.outcome:
1. Working closely with client incident and problem management team, at least three high severity incidents were de-escalated within a month
2. Together with zero escalations for the quarter, the number of tickets being reopened by customer dropped by up to 30%
3. Lowered MTTR by 50% since teams began leveraging the playbooks and also stayed motivated to supplement it with their own

plan306090.days30: Build context: map stakeholders, services, and SLOs. Ship small observability wins and fix the top one or two reliability gaps.
plan306090.days60: Deepen impact: own a meaningful slice of the roadmap, reduce toil through automation, and align metrics with business outcomes.
plan306090.days90: Lead by example: drive a cross-team initiative (performance, security, or developer experience), mentor others, and leave durable runbooks and architecture notes.
